WITH event_averages AS (
    SELECT link_to_event,
           AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT ea.link_to_event,
           ea.avg_amount,
           ea.avg_amount - oa.avg_amount AS above_overall_gap
    FROM event_averages ea
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.avg_amount
),
with_above_mean AS (
    SELECT *, AVG(avg_amount) OVER () AS mean_above_average
    FROM above_average
)
SELECT link_to_event,
       avg_amount,
       above_overall_gap,
       avg_amount - mean_above_average AS gap_from_above_average_mean
FROM with_above_mean
ORDER BY gap_from_above_average_mean DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is over non-NULL budget.amount values across all budget lines, so each line has equal weight; events with no non-NULL amounts are omitted.
